title: Astral experiences to places I felt were real - Have you seen these two places?

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have seen two specific recurring astral/lucid locations (casino on Pluto; house/facility on a mountain hillside)

meta.author_theory: Mentions 'astral police' stopping out-of-body travel; references claim about disguised elevators in government buildings used for wormhole space travel; describes building materials as non-earthly/overlaid; reports an authoritative compassionate voice message.

locations.location_name: government or office building (Earth) with elevator

qualities.raw_description: Elevator in some sort of government or office building; many people in suits and ties (mostly men).

locations.location_name: elevator that transforms into a box-shaped traveling craft

position.relative_to: starts in government/office building and then travels through a wormhole into space

qualities.raw_description: Elevator 'sort of transformed into a traveling UFO in the shape of a box' like a 'doctor who' flying box; lifted up and into a worm hole; felt like speed of light; passing planets; arrived within minutes.

position.relative_to: destination after elevator/craft travel; described as on Pluto

qualities.raw_description: Some sort of 'fun house casino'; 'very corrupt' with 'feeling of corruption everywhere'; people playing with gold coins; many playing tables; alcoholic bar; interior finish red and gold, 'lots of red'.

locations.location_name: mountain hillside/countryside (Europe-like), summer, wildflowers; remote acreage

position.relative_to: surrounding area of the 3-4 story house/facility

qualities.raw_description: Deep in the countryside somewhere in Europe; 'wild flowers that cover the hillside and mountains all around'; 'Its summer'; far away from civilization; '100's if not 1000's of acres'; later seen from above when flying away.

locations.location_name: 3–4 story house/mansion that is also a facility

position.relative_to: located on a hillside in mountains/countryside

qualities.raw_description: Looks like a 3-4 story house (mansion) but is a 'facility of sorts'; later described as not made of earthly matter; tangible and looks real.
Inside are 'long white hallways'; very 'lab' like.

locations.location_name: row of changing rooms with brown gate-like swing slotted doors

qualities.raw_description: A whole row of 'changing rooms' with 'brown gate-like swing styled slotted doors'; inside: 'costumes, wigs, and creepy outfits'.

locations.location_name: window area in facility (with chair nearby)

position.relative_to: inside the facility, at a window

qualities.raw_description: Dreamer rushes to a window, sees a chair; throws chair at window; glass shatters; an electric blue line appears and within seconds rebuilds the damaged window.

position.relative_to: outside after passing through wall; hundreds of feet away from facility

qualities.raw_description: Dreamer 'leapt THROUGH the wall' and 'out into the sky'; flew 'as quick as a hummingbird' hundreds of feet away; looked back down and saw green hillside with wildflowers.

locations.location_name: bedside / trance state (later experiences of being stopped)

qualities.raw_description: In a trance-like state heard a voice say 'You've seen enough'; felt a 'huge, many thousands of pounds BLACK weight' fall on top of body; heard two men at side of bed saying 'It's time to reset her..' wearing lab coats.

connections.qualities: Elevator ride begins normally with suited people; then transforms into box-shaped craft and enters a wormhole.
Travel through wormhole at near light speed; passes planets; arrives at Pluto and disembarks.
Dreamer gets back on the elevator to leave the casino.
Dreamer flies in astral form to the mountainside facility at very high speed ('nearly move at the speed of light').
Movement through interior long white hallways.
Dreamer floats over and opens a changing-room door with brown gate-like swing slotted design.
Dreamer rushes to a window area to attempt escape.
Dreamer passes through a wall and exits into the sky, flying hundreds of feet away.

boundaries.description: Window acts as a barrier: chair shatters the glass, then an 'ELECTRIC blue line' appears and within seconds rebuilds the window, preventing exit.

interactions.description: Dreamer gets into an elevator with a bunch of people in suits; they cannot see or interact with the dreamer.

entities_involved.description: Mostly men in suits and ties in elevator

interactions.description: Elevator transforms into a box-shaped craft; travels through a wormhole; passes planets; arrives at Pluto within minutes.

entities_involved.description: Same suited passengers; still not interacting with dreamer

interactions.description: Dreamer wanders the casino; sees people playing with gold coins, many playing tables, and an alcoholic bar; notes red and gold interior and strong sense of corruption; leaves via elevator.

entities_involved.description: People playing with gold coins at tables

interactions.description: Dreamer encounters orphaned children; they crowd around, point, and try to touch/talk; dreamer asks where parents are and why they are there.

entities_involved.description: At least 10 children aged ~6–12; excited; perceive dreamer as apparition; one boy: very fair skin, bright red curly hair like an afro, freckles, vacant/disassociated look

interactions.description: Dreamer opens a changing-room door and looks inside; sees costumes, wigs, and creepy outfits; experiences stomach sinking, heart racing, and rage.
Dreamer attempts to break a window with a chair to get children out; glass shatters; an electric blue line appears and rebuilds the window; children say escape is impossible.

entities_involved.description: Children say: 'You can't get out of here, its impossible'

interactions.transaction_blocker: Window instantly reconstructs after shattering (electric blue line rebuilds it).

interactions.description: A man in a suit busts into the facility and runs down the hallway toward the dreamer and children; dreamer passes through wall and escapes into the sky.

entities_involved.description: Man in a suit running down the hallway

interactions.description: From the sky, dreamer looks down to memorize the place and sees the green hillside and wildflowers around the mountains; hears an etheric male voice speaking.

entities_involved.description: Etheric male voice; 'authoritative nature... full of compassion and authority'; says: 'This is but a taste of what will happen in the future... You are looking at Fallen Earth, Plan B... I need you to be here just a little while longer'

interactions.description: In trance/bed state: hears voice say 'You've seen enough'; experiences huge black weight pressing down; hears two men at side of bed saying 'It's time to reset her..' wearing lab coats.

entities_involved.description: Voice: 'You've seen enough'; two men in lab coats at bedside: 'It's time to reset her..'

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes two main astral/lucid episodes (casino on Pluto; mountain facility/house) plus later bedside/trance events about being prevented from astral projection. Some qualities (lighting/cleanliness/crowding) are not explicitly stated and left not_mentioned. Time flow marked compressed due to 'within minutes' travel across solar system and very high-speed flight.
